answers.answer: Shuffle 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards as the draw deck. Put 6 Heat face up in the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
answers.evidence: Setup steps 4–8: "Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards"; "Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot"; "Set Gear pawn to 1st gear"; "Draw 7 cards".

answers.answer: Yes, staying in gear is allowed. Shifting from 1st to 3rd costs 1 Heat, paid immediately during Shift Gears from Engine to discard. The Heat must be available then.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: "Stay in your current gear"; "shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step: move a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile".

answers.answer: No. In 3rd gear commit 3 cards face down.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: "Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number"; "3rd = 3".

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous among players, performed in that order. Everyone must finish both before step 3 starts. Each player then finishes all steps 3–9 before the next begins step 3. Front cars act first; side by side, the car closest to the Race Line acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: "Wait until everyone has finished both steps before starting step 3." Sequential Phase: "Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next player begins step 3"; "the car closest to the Race Line is ahead for all purposes, including turn order".

answers.answer: Cars never block passage. If the destination is full, use the first free spot behind the blocking cars. Prefer the spot closest to the Race Line when available.
answers.evidence: Blocked Movement: "Cars never block passage"; "first free spot behind the blocking cars". Reveal & Move: "Place your car on the spot closest to the Race Line if available".

answers.answer: Immediately discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade cards. Put Speed 3 on top of the played Stress in the Play Area; the Stress stays underneath and supplies speed 3. Both are discarded during Replenish Hand. Resolve this before Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: "Immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card, including Heat, Stress and Starting Upgrade cards"; "Put the found Speed card in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card"; "Discard both during Replenish Hand"; "Resolve all played Stress cards before moving on to Adrenaline".

answers.answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline in a five-car race. Each gets 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed during React. The extra speed can be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed"; "before or after Boost"; "Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved for another round".

answers.answer: Yes. Second gear provides Cooldown 1, which can move that Heat from hand to Engine. Immediately spend it from Engine to discard to Boost. React allows Cooldown and Boost in any order.
answers.evidence: Cooldown: "2nd gear (Cooldown 1)". React: "Activate available Cooldown and/or Boost symbols in any order. You may Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost".

answers.answer: Boost once per turn during React, paying 1 Heat from Engine to discard. With an empty Engine you cannot Boost unless you first return Heat using available Cooldown. Flip until a Speed card appears, immediately discarding non-Speed cards; put the Speed card in the Play Area and move its value. This speed counts for corner checks.
answers.evidence: Boost: "Once per turn during React, pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard"; "until you reveal a Speed card"; "Add that Speed card to your Play Area and move its value"; "Boost increases your total speed for corner checks". Paying Heat permits Cooldown before Boost.

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. Check speed 6, since its movement does not increase speed. Pay 2 Heat for the limit-4 corner.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: "optionally move 2 spaces forward"; "does NOT increase your speed for corner checks, but crossing a Corner Line this way still requires checking that corner". Check Corner: "pay Heat equal to the excess".

answers.answer: Check both corners in crossed order: limit 6, then limit 4. At speed 8 pay 2 Heat and 4 Heat respectively, totaling 6 Heat.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: "Check every Corner Line crossed this turn ... in the order crossed"; "For each corner separately"; "Use the same total speed for each corner".

answers.answer: You need 3 Heat but have only 2, so discard both remaining Engine Heat and spin out. Return the car to the first available space before the corner that caused the spin out. Take 2 extra Stress directly into hand because you were in 4th gear. Set gear to 1st.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: "move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile"; "first available space before the corner"; "2 if you were in 3rd/4th gear" directly into hand; "move your Gear pawn to 1st gear".

answers.answer: You may discard unwanted Speed cards, but not Stress or Heat. You may browse neither your own nor another player’s discard pile. Only each pile’s top card is public.
answers.evidence: Discard: "Optionally discard unwanted cards from hand, but never Stress or Heat cards. Nobody may browse any discard pile, including their own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge".

answers.answer: Discard all Play Area cards, then draw only enough to bring your hand to 7, not seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: "Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7. Do not draw seven additional cards".

answers.answer: Immediately shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck and continue the interrupted Stress flips. Do not include Play Area cards, since they have not yet been discarded.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: "immediately shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, then continue the interrupted draws or flips"; "This applies during Stress"; "Do not include cards still in your Play Area".

answers.answer: Pay Heat from Engine to discard. It can later enter the shuffled draw deck, be drawn into hand, and return to Engine through Cooldown. Normally you cannot play or voluntarily discard Heat from hand; the forced Cluttered Hand handling is an exception.
answers.evidence: Paying Heat: "move that many Heat cards from your Engine to your discard pile". Heat Card Cycle: "Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown". Special Rules: "Heat cards cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand".

answers.answer: Commit the two playable cards and two Heat to fill four slots. Move zero spaces, set gear to 1st, and discard all four committed cards, including the two Heat. Skip directly to step 9 to replenish. You skip React and cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: "commit all playable cards you can and fill the remaining required slots with Heat cards"; "moves zero spaces"; "Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards"; "skip directly to step 9"; "You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn".

answers.answer: Crossing first does not automatically win if multiple cars finish in the same round. Furthest ahead wins; closest to Race Line breaks side-by-side ties. Remove all cars that crossed the final finish line at the end of the round and place them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: "If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties)"; "At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line".

answers.answer: You cannot Slipstream across the finish line on the final lap or Slipstream after crossing it by normal movement. After crossing the final finish line, ignore corner speed limits beyond it and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: "On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line, and cannot Slipstream after crossing it"; "ignore the speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can".

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline. Use the six cars that started the race, so the last two cars to move still receive the benefits after four finishers leave.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "Use the number of cars that started the race, even after finishers leave the track".
